card.name: Linking words in oncology survival and treatment text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or symbols in cancer drug-label text, especially "and/or" just before "overall survival". Also fires on words like "with", "receiving", "or" or "(" in lists of cancer drugs and patient groups.

modes.label: and/or before overall survival
modes.description: The "/or" part of "and/or" right before "overall survival" in warnings about reduced progression-free survival.
